verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Parrrley range before E is ready; you win if you land E then chain Q-W-R before he cleanses with W.

brief.thesis: Gangplank's Parrrley (625 range) outreaches Darius's E (Apprehend, 535 range) and melee kit entirely, and early on Darius has no reliable way to close that gap since E starts on a 26s cooldown — this is why Gangplank holds the lane advantage. But Gangplank has zero dash or escape in his kit; his only outs are summoners and the reactive heal/cleanse on W (Remove Scurvy), so once Darius actually lands the pull the fight tilts hard. The 47.2% head-to-head over 2916 games reflects that coinflip: whoever controls when the engage happens controls the lane.

theirWindow.when: Levels 1-5, before your E is up
theirWindow.what: He can freely poke with Parrrley at 625 range while your E (Apprehend) sits on a 26-16s cooldown; don't walk up for extra CS or trades you can't punish.

yourWindow.when: Level 6+, his W is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Land E to pull him in, stack Hemorrhage with auto-attacks and Q (Decimate), slow with W (Crippling Strike), then finish with R (Noxian Guillotine) for true damage before he can cleanse or heal it off.

powerCurve.note: No E yet, pure poke range mismatch
E unlocked but 26-21s cooldown, still poke-dominant
R execute threat flips landed all-ins
Youmuu's/Dead Man's Plate close his range edge

start.why: Runs at 47.8% over 1913 games and is the majority pick (53.8%) because the regen and damage reduction directly offset Grog-Soaked Blade poison ticks and repeated Parrrley chip during the levels where you can't fight back.

boots.why: The clear majority pick (79.3%, 46.5% WR) — flat physical damage reduction blunts his auto-attack and Parrrley harassment through the laning phase.

core.why: The active dash and haste is how you actually close the 625-vs-535 range gap on demand instead of waiting on E's cooldown to force a fight.
Stacking move speed closes distance in a straight line and gives the HP/armor to survive poke long enough to land your full combo.
Converts incoming burst into a DoT and heals it back, which matters against a lane built entirely around chip damage from Parrrley and Grog-Soaked Blade.

situational.when: his poke and poison damage over the course of the game is outpacing your sustain
you're getting burst down before you can finish your E-into-R combo
you want a mythic active with a built-in slow to lock him down instead of Youmuu's pure dash

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror stacks through the extended auto/Q/W trades you're forced into and heals you back, which is exactly what offsets Grog-Soaked Blade's poison over a prolonged fight before your R finishes it.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite runs the best winrate among common pages (49.1% over significant sample) — Ignite's true damage secures the kill off your R all-in before his W can heal him out of range, and Flash guarantees you can close distance when E is down. Exhaust+Flash (49.8% WR, smaller sample) is a reasonable alternative if you want to neuter his Parrrley poke and Cannon Barrage damage directly.

playing.title: Don't fight outside E range
playing.detail: Only commit to trades when Gangplank is within your E (Apprehend)'s 535 range; outside that he freely lands Parrrley at 625 range with zero reprisal.

playing.title: Track his Remove Scurvy cooldown
playing.detail: W (Remove Scurvy) clears CC and heals him on a 22-18s cooldown — time your all-in for when it's down so your Crippling Strike slow and R damage actually stick.

playing.title: Use Q to stack, not to poke
playing.detail: Decimate's blade-edge bonus damage and heal only apply when he's actually in melee range, so save it for trades instead of fishing from max range.

playing.title: All-in the instant R is up
playing.detail: Once level 6 hits, punish any overextension immediately — stack 5 Hemorrhage with autos and Q, slow with W, then Guillotine for true damage before he can sustain back.

playing.title: Respect levels 1-5 completely
playing.detail: You have no reliable gap closer until E ranks up past 23.5s cooldown — don't push for extra CS into his point-blank poke range.

playing.title: Rush mobility before pure damage
playing.detail: Youmuu's Ghostblade's active and Dead Man's Plate's stacking speed are what let you actually close his range advantage — they matter more here than raw damage items.

playing.title: Watch for his mana drain on Parrrley
playing.detail: Parrrley only refunds mana on a kill, so prolonged poke exchanges where he's not finishing you drain his mana — look for safer all-in windows once he's running low.

brief.patchCaveat: The build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and the 47.2% head-to-head win rate over 2916 games are measured from current-patch games on OP.GG; the lane timing windows and trade logic are my own reading of how the two kits interact.

stats.opponentTip: Fight Gangplank whenever he stands in your range to either kill him or get a Summoner’s Spell from him. Be careful of his Graps of the Undying + (Q) combo.
